title: A Herdr pane's latest agent reply
description: HERDR-11: `GET /v1/herdr/panes/{pane}/reply`, in the device's selected session. For a codex or claude pane, the agent's latest reply as plain text, read from the agent's own session log (codex's rollout under `~/.codex/sessions`, Claude Code's project log under `~/.claude/projects`) - read-only, a byte-offset tail, never the PTY. The log is tied to the pane through the pane's processes (`pane.process_info`, then `/proc`): codex by the rollout open in its process tree (or its one thread lock), claude by a `--resume`/`--session-id` on its command line or by its working folder when it is the only claude there; a Herdr that reports the agent's session itself is believed first. Anything that cannot be matched reliably is `available: false` with a `reason` (`not_an_agent`, `no_match`, `ambiguous`, `no_reply`) that a client never shows: it shows no reply at all. `text` is at most 32 KiB (`truncated`). `complete` is whether the agent's turn ended after this reply (null when the log does not say). `phase` is codex's own label (`commentary` while it works, `final_answer`). `ETag` answers `If-None-Match` with 304. `404 herdr_pane_gone` for a pane the session no longer has. Native and web credentials.
